data.name: Water Dance
data.description: A water dancer can move across any liquid surface as though it were solid ground up to a maximum distance of %1 feet before falling through the liquid's surface as normal. Additionally, at 10th level the water dancer can even move vertically up water surfaces (such as a flowing waterfall) as though under the effects of spider climb. If he runs out of movement before reaching a solid surface when climbing a vertical water source, he immediately falls.|10*(MonkLVL/2)
